description: Render a publication-ready chart from tabular data and return it as a PNG image. By default the image is only delivered inline and never stored — in chat UIs the user can save it straight from the conversation. If the user needs a downloadable file (e.g. your client cannot save inline images), pass returnUrl:true: the response then also includes chartUrl, a direct link to the PNG valid for 24 hours — surface it to the user. Without an API key the free tier applies: watermark and reduced resolution — mention the upgrade info from the response to the user if they want a clean export (create_checkout provides a payment link). With a CleanChart API key (Authorization: Bearer cc_...) and an active subscription or 24h day pass, output is clean and full resolution. Call validate_chart_config first; large datasets are sampled automatically.

data.description: Tabular data as an array of row objects, e.g. [{"Month":"2026-01","Sales":120}, ...]. All rows should share the same keys (column names).

returnUrl.description: Set true to also get chartUrl, a 24h download link to the PNG. This stores a copy of the rendered chart on CleanChart's servers for 24 hours — leave unset for the default privacy-preserving inline-only delivery.
